ops.old: Brush flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar. Grill over high heat until blistered and charred in spots. Spoon hummus into a bowl, make a well and scatter with pomegranate seeds and a drizzle of oil. Tear the bread and dip.
ops.new: Brush flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with sesame and cumin. Grill over high heat until blistered and charred in spots. Spoon hummus into a bowl, make a well and scatter with pomegranate seeds and a drizzle of oil. Tear the bread and dip.

ops.new: Flatbreads brushed with olive oil, sprinkled with sesame and cumin and grilled until blistered, torn and served with hummus scattered with pomegranate seeds.
